conviction_note: FY9/26 was pre-released on 2026-09-01 (OP 860m), so this print turns on the first FY9/27 guide and the new mid-term plan the company has said it will issue at this print; the company has written down that it guides only on high-certainty assumptions and will keep making upfront investments, and last year's FY print (an investment-led OP cut) fell 27.5%, so I lean modestly negative (p_up 45 on abs 9 = -0.9); the findings net to only -0.2 because a new, more ambitious mid-term plan is a real positive offset, and the gap between the two numbers is that offset plus a stock that has sold every 2026 upward revision.
bar: FY9/26 bar = the company's own revised forecast, net sales 5,850m / OP 860m / ordinary 860m / NI 740m (Notice of Revisions, 2026-09-01, https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260901/140120260828527770.pdf). No IFIS/analyst consensus exists (kabuyoho shows consensus '--', https://kabuyoho.jp/report?bcode=4479) and no 四季報 FY9/27 number could be sourced, so the FY9/27 bar is unsourced and every guidance finding is capped small.
positioning_check: JPX disclosed short register: 0.0% (no position >=0.5%), change 0.0 pts, as of 2026-10-26 (baseline, https://www.jpx.co.jp/markets/public/short-selling/index.html). No crowded short to squeeze; a standing margin-long overhang. No skew (no option market). Run-up 20d -6.59%, 5d -2.23%; spot 922 is below the 967 close before the Sept upward revision.

findings.finding: The first FY9/27 guide is likely to be set conservatively and to carry stepped-up investment: the 2026-09-01 revision notice states the company only incorporates assumptions with sufficient certainty and explicitly does not pre-include large-project upside, and that it will make strategic upfront investments flexibly; the Q3 deck says SG&A rose on 'investment for next year and beyond' and Q4 OP will be roughly flat on last year (implied Q4 OP ~16m: 860 - 844). FY9/26 OP 860m was driven by large gadget/appliance projects the company says it will not bake in.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Last FY print (2025-10-28, released 15:30) guided FY9/26 OP 400m (-10.6%) on upfront investment after an 8-day rally; stock -267 yen to 743 next day (baseline -27.52%). The prior FY print (Oct 2024) moved +7.16%.
findings.why_not_priced: There is no consensus or 四季報 number to have priced a FY9/27 figure against, and the stock trades at ~15.9x FY9/26 EPS of 58 yen, a multiple that assumes growth continues; if holders had priced a flat-to-down guide the stock would not have held above 900 after the September revision faded. Partly priced: the policy is public and holders saw last year's -27.5%, which is why this is sized well under the proxy.
findings.independence: Q3 FY9/26 presentation (2026-07-28) says investment is being stepped up for next year and Q4 OP will be about last year's level, https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260728/140120260716595347.pdf; FY9/25 guide precedent, https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=4479&b=n202510280926. Same issuer, different documents.

findings.finding: A new mid-term plan is due with these results: the Q3 deck says the FY9/25-FY9/27 plan (FY9/27 sales 52億, OP 7億) is within reach a year early, will be revised on the FY9/26 full-year landing, and a 'new growth image' is being drawn up; FY9/26's revised forecast (sales 5,850m, OP 860m) already exceeds both FY9/27 targets.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior mid-term plan launch can be dated in the baseline; the Jan 2026 Q1 print, the one 2026 print that showed the growth acceleration first, went limit-up (+15.48%).
findings.why_not_priced: The old targets are already met in the stock's current numbers, so the market has no stated multi-year target to price beyond FY9/26; a new plan with a higher OP path would be new information. If it were priced the stock would trade above the post-revision level, not 5% below it.
findings.independence: The 2026-09-01 revision notice confirms FY9/26 above the FY9/27 targets (OP 860m vs 700m), https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260901/140120260828527770.pdf. Partly shares the Q3 deck with finding 1.

findings.finding: FY9/26 actuals are pre-released (OP 860m revised 2026-09-01, Q3 cumulative already 844m) and the company landed above its last revised plan a year ago (FY9/25 OP 447m vs 430m plan), so a small beat of the 860m is the likely quarter-level read.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Every 2026 upward revision or beat except January was sold: 2026-04-28 revision -5.98%, 2026-07-28 Q3 (OP doubled) -16.5%, 2026-09-01 revision opened up and closed -49 yen (918).
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: the number is pre-released to within a few percent, so this is near zero by construction; the only unpriced part is the size of the overshoot, which is small.
findings.independence: kabuyoho progress table: ordinary profit 848m at Q3 = 98.6% of the 860m forecast, https://kabuyoho.jp/report?bcode=4479.

findings.finding: Representative-director role change announced 2026-10-09: co-CEO Fumiaki Kiuchi becomes 代表取締役社長 and founder Ryotaro Nakayama becomes 代表取締役 from 2026-12-17, co-representative structure kept; the results call on 10-27 17:00 is still hosted by Nakayama.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No reaction history; the announcement day itself shows no news-driven move on kabutan.
findings.why_not_priced: Public for 18 days and structurally neutral; filed for completeness, sized at zero.
findings.independence: Results briefing notice naming Nakayama as speaker, https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20261001/140120260928540849.pdf.

baseline_tension: The lean is mildly negative against a baseline lean of +0.33 (driven by the -6.6% run-up) and zero short interest, so there is no squeeze fuel either way; the strongest positive the release could carry is a new mid-term plan with a materially higher OP path (filed at +1.0) or a first capital return (looked, no evidence), and holders have already watched last year's investment-led guide cut, which is why p_up sits only 5 points under 50.
lessons_applied: Rule 2 (negatives outnumber positives): wrote the strongest positive into baseline_tension and confirmed I had looked for returns and the new mid-term plan; moved p_up from 42 to 45.
Core table 'the bar is unsourced': with no consensus or 四季報 FY9/27 number, trimmed the FY9/27 guidance finding from -2.0 to -1.5.
